jobs.description:
This Belgian manufacturer of dry powder mixtures for the construction industry (mortars, adhesives, plasters, etc.), located in the Port of Antwerp, is looking to strengthen its current team with a motivated OPERATOR.

As an OPERATOR, you will be responsible for all operational tasks required during your shift for production and loading activities. You will play a crucial role in the production process and will be widely deployable across various production lines, from mixing processes to bagging.

Your responsibilities as an OPERATOR* will include:

• Preparing, weighing and accurately dosing raw materials and additives for mixing processes, particularly liquids.
• Monitoring and operating mixing and filling machines, such as dissolvers, mixing tanks and filling equipment.
• Operating, converting and setting up bagging machines.
• Setting up and loading packaging materials (e.g. film) onto the machines.
• Carrying out process checks and visual inspections of the finished product, such as checking viscosity and colour consistency.
• Replacing simple mechanical components on the production lines.
• Processing residual product and cleaning the factory, including cleaning mixing equipment and pipelines.
• Assisting drivers during loading operations.
• Carrying out internal transport and logistical activities using a forklift and/or reach truck.

REF:MEC1

Experience & Profile

• You have proven relevant work experience as an OPERATOR in a production environment.
• Experience with mixing, dispersing or filling liquids, or operating bagging and packaging machines, is preferred.
• A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate is a major advantage.
• You are familiar with terminology and techniques used in the mixing industry, such as batch production, dosing and basic quality control
• You have a technical aptitude and a strong problem-solving mindset.
• You are communicative and have a good command of Dutch or English

jobs.occupation: Customer Experience Specialist France - Region Kontich
jobs.description:
Our client is looking for a Customer Experience Specialist to support and further develop their French-speaking customer base. In this role, you will ensure an outstanding customer journey from order placement to delivery and after-sales support while building long-term customer relationships.

 

Client Details

Our client is an internationally recognised company, operating within the lifestyle industry. 
With a strong focus on innovation and customer satisfaction, our client has built an excellent reputation in both B2B and B2C markets. To strengthen their customer experience team, they are currently looking for a service-driven professional with a strong affinity for the French market.
 
Company is located in the region of Kontich/Edegem. Easy connection with car & public transport.

 

Description

• Act as the primary point of contact for customers in the French market (B2B).
• Advise customers on products, collections, and available solutions.
• Handle customer enquiries via phone and email in a professional and solution-oriented manner.
• Process, manage, and follow up on orders within the ERP system.
• Coordinate the order flow and ensure timely delivery to customers.
• Work closely with the sales, logistics, and planning teams to guarantee a seamless customer experience.
• Manage customer complaints and provide effective and customer-focused solutions.
• Support commercial initiatives, quotations, and after-sales activities.
• Identify opportunities to improve processes, communication, and customer service.
• Contribute actively to customer loyalty and long-term customer relationships.
 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in customer service, internal sales or customer support.
• Native-level French proficiency.
• Good command of English.
• Strong affinity with French culture and the French market.
• Experience within lifestyle or premium consumer goods sector is considered a strong asset.
• Commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for additional sales.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Solution-oriented and able to perform effectively under pressure.
• Excellent communication skills and customer-centric attitude.
• Team player with a proactive mindset.
• Passion for premium-quality products.

Do you want to make a difference every day in an innovative production environment? As an Assistant Operator on our non-woven production team, you’ll have the chance to work with a lead operator to create quality products like dishcloths and mops. Your commitment and sense of responsibility are the keys to your team’s success and the quality of our products.

No two days are the same! You’ll supply raw materials with a forklift, perform quality checks, and adjust the production process where needed. You’ll also move product rolls to the warehouse and help maintain a safe and tidy workplace by participating in weekly cleaning routines. Thanks to the 2-shift system, you’ll enjoy variety in your working hours, making it easier to balance work and personal life.

Are you ready to grow, learn new skills, and make a positive impact? Step into this dynamic role today and help us build the future of non-woven products. Let us hear from you—apply now!

• You have technical and operational skills, with a basic understanding of production techniques

• Order, cleanliness, and safety come naturally to you

• You’re not afraid to take initiative and have a strong sense of responsibility

• You can work independently and are also a true team player

• You’re flexible and communicate easily

• You have a good command of English

• Forklift experience is a plus, but you can also earn your certificate with us

• At least lower secondary education

• Whether you’re a starter or have up to 2 years of experience, your motivation is what counts

• Soft skills like engagement, discipline, perseverance, energy, and collegiality make you stand out

Are you looking to kickstart your career in construction? Join us as a General Construction Worker where every day is a new opportunity to make a tangible impact. You'll be working on varied projects, gaining hands-on experience in demolition, masonry, insulation, and more. 

Your typical day will be dynamic and rewarding. You'll assist skilled workers, ensure site safety, and help maintain project flow. Your contribution is critical in creating structures that stand strong and look impressive. 

Ready to put your skills to the test and grow with us? Apply today and be part of a team that values your effort and dedication.

• Experience in construction (minimum one year)

• Communicative English skills

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow in construction

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation (a plus)

• VCA certificate

jobs.occupation: CE Dump Truck Driver – Reliable Shuttle Between Sint-Katelijne-Waver & Hemiksem
jobs.description:
As a CE Dump Truck Driver (m/f/x), you are responsible for daily shuttle transport between Sint-Katelijne-Waver and Hemiksem. You operate a tipper truck to ensure goods are loaded, transported, and unloaded safely and correctly. Safety, punctuality, and a strong sense of responsibility are key in this role.

Your average workday begins with a vehicle inspection. You load materials, depart on time to the next location, and ensure smooth delivery. In addition to transporting goods, you handle transport documents correctly and comply with driving and rest time regulations. You keep your truck clean and well-maintained. After your shift, you may take the truck home.

Can you see yourself driving between these two fixed sites for a reliable client? Apply today and secure a stable, well-paid job with future prospects!

• You have a valid CE driving license

• You are up to date with Code 95 and medical examination

• Experience with tipper transport is a plus, not a must

• You are punctual, reliable, and able to work independently

• You have a strong sense of responsibility

• You speak and understand basic Dutch or English

• You have at least lower secondary education

• 0 to 5 years of experience is sufficient

• Both junior and medior profiles are welcome

jobs.occupation: Facade Painter – Working at Heights F/X/M
jobs.description:
Step up to a career that reaches new heights! As a Facade Painter, you'll play a crucial role in transforming and maintaining industrial and commercial buildings. Your expertise will shine as you handle various exterior painting projects, ensuring that every stroke of your brush adds value and beauty.   In your day-to-day role, you'll prepare and clean facades, apply primers and topcoats, and work with precision from scaffolding or aerial platforms. Your keen eye for detail and commitment to safety will ensure that every project is completed to the highest standard.   Ready to elevate your career? Apply now to join a team that values precision, safety, and craftsmanship, and where your skills will be put to great use every single day.

• Experience as an exterior or industrial painter is a strong plus

• Communicative English

• No fear of heights – experience with aerial platforms or rope techniques is an asset

• Ability to work neatly with an eye for detail

• Adherence to safety rules and enjoy working outdoors

• VCA certificate is a plus (or willingness to obtain one)

• Driving license B is an asset

Are you ready to take your skills to the next level as a Die Cutting Machine Operator? We're looking for someone like you to join our dynamic team. You'll set up and operate cutting-edge machinery in a fast-paced environment, ensuring precision and quality in every product.

In this role, you'll start your day by setting up the die cutter based on order specifications. Your keen eye for detail will ensure everything is in its right place, from adjusting feeder plates to installing dies. You'll work across two shifts, maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency to meet production goals.

Ready to make your mark in an industry-leading company? Apply today and become part of a team that values precision, quality, and innovation.

• Minimum of 2 years experience as a Die Cutting Machine Operator

• Technical knowledge, gained through studies or practical experience

• Communicative knowledge of English

• Affinity with technology and attention to detail

• Willingness to work two shifts: 1st shift from Monday to Thursday, 5:15 to 13:15, and Friday, 5:00 to 13:00; 2nd shift from Monday to Thursday, 13:15 to 21:15, and Friday, 11:00 to 17:00

Are you ready to take your career in offset printing to the next level? We are seeking a skilled Offset Printer to ensure our high-quality standards are met in every print run. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a team that values precision, efficiency, and teamwork.

In this role, your day will start by setting up and operating our state-of-the-art offset printing machines. You will be responsible for maintaining the printers, ensuring consistent quality, and troubleshooting any issues that arise during the production process. Collaboration is key as you'll work alongside other professionals to meet production goals and deadlines.

If you're passionate about printing and looking for a role where your contributions are valued, apply now! Join us and become an integral part of a workplace that offers growth and learning opportunities.

• At least 2-3 years of experience as an offset printer
• Technical qualifications in printing at A2/A3 level or equivalent experience
• Experience in multi-color offset printing; experience in printing on solid board or CBA is an additional advantage
• Team player with strong communication skills and the ability to maintain a collaborative work environment
• Attention to detail with an excellent sense of quality and safety
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch

For an international and technically oriented organization active in industrial solutions, we are looking for an Inside Sales (Italian) profile with strong language skills and a commercial mindset.

Are you customer-oriented, do you have a technical interest, and are you fluent in Italian, combined with English? Then this is an interesting opportunity.

 
• Actively developing new customer relationships (±30%) and maintaining existing clients (±70%)
 
• Preparing quotations and price calculations
 
• Processing and following up on orders
 
• Customer contact via phone and email, with a focus on cross-selling and digitalization
 
• Managing and updating customer data in the internal system
 
• Gaining insight into customer needs, applications, and market conditions
 
• Acting as the first point of contact for questions, support, and complaints
 
• Identifying and capitalizing on commercial opportunities
 
• Close collaboration with sales colleagues and reporting on ongoing cases

 
• You have a technical and/or commercial background
 
• You are fluent in Italian, in addition to English
 
• Good knowledge of Excel and common IT tools
 
• Strong communication skills and customer focus
 
• You are proactive, structured, and commercially minded
 
• You perform well in a dynamic and growing environment

jobs.occupation: Customer Service | Czech + English + Eastern-European Language
jobs.description:
Are you a born problem solver with a passion for customer satisfaction? Do you want to work in an international environment where no day is the same? Then we have the perfect challenge for you! At Volvo, they are looking for an enthusiastic customer service representative to join their Central-East team and contribute to their mission of getting vehicles back on the road quickly and efficiently. Your duties: 

 
• Provide first line support for international breakdowns: Wherever our customers are in Europe, you will be there to help them and address their concerns. 
 

 
• Maintain regular contact with dealers and customers: So that everyone is always informed about the progress of repairs. 
 

 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 
 Keywords: customer support advisor, customer service, call agent, customer service representative
Bachelor thinking level. Fluent in English + Czech + one of following: Polish, Lithuanian, German (minimum B2 level). 

Flexible in working hours: Working in a full-time system is not a problem for you; rather, you enjoy the variety. Driving license B: You must be able to come to the company independently.
